messages:
samir: heads up — we're seeing a bunch of fncall validation rejects turn into routing fallbacks and quota churn this morning. sample error: `validation error: missing required field 'result.items'` and then the router sends to degen model and charges full tokens. cc @maya

maya: ugh. where in pipeline? is this validator strictness change from last canary?

samir: looks like new strict schema (v2) landed in canary at 03:25 UTC. 3k rejects over 10m, ~40% triggered fallback route 'degen-v1'.

liam: can we surface these in console as a severity ladder? infra wants quick filter: rejects -> fallbacks -> billable-fallthrough

elaine: agree. current dashboard buckets are too coarse. telemetry tag suggestion: `validation.severity: soft|hard|break` and `routing.outcome: accept|fallback|drop`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary 2026-03-20T03:25 rolled to 12% instances in us-west. Reverting now? :warning:

jack: don't revert yet. we should throttle strictness server-side and add sampling flag. Quick patch: make strict validator soft-fail for content-type 'toolcall' for 30m.

maya: patch sounds good. also need alert rule: when fallback rate for fncall > 5% AND fallback billable-tokens > 1k/min -> page oncall.

samir: putting a patch up: `PATCH: validator:soften_toolcall_mode=true` pushing to canary now and adding telemetry tags. logs:
```
validation=soft mode=true route=fallback degen=false tokens_billed=124
```

liam: I'll add console UX change - new chart 'fncall validation flow' with stacked series: rejects, fallbacks, billable_fallback_tokens. ETA end of day.

elaine: also add an audit column with offending schema example (redact PII) — helps triage.

samir: thanks. will follow up with post-mortem if rates don't drop in 30m. :thumbsup:
